detail.title: Longmouth
detail.body: Longmouth is a company started by some friends in Denmark/SF, whose journey I am privileged to be a part of. I have worked closely with the founders to bring their vision to life, creating a very custom single-page web experience for their Magic The Gathering apparel store. The customer-facing site is built in Webflow, using Smootify to integrate with Shopify for its inventory management and e-commerce tools. The decision to build the site in this manner came from a desire to quickly launch a fully functional online store while maintaining a high level of design customization. While the goal is to eventually migrate the entire site to Shopify, this approach has allowed us to iterate on the design and functionality rapidly.
